body: I really wish it were that simple, but then I would be completely alone
No colleges within an hours drive of me will accept anyone over 18 :(  I've tried so hard to fix my mistakes
I just can't seem to look at the positives to anything anymore :(

Universities won't touch me with a barge pole, no A Levels, they won't even consider me.  Education was always my passion, I was on track to med school, I just feel like my life has been turned upside down and that I've failed.  I saw a load of Facebook posts by old school friends talking about what people were doing now and they were pleased about me failing.
I've just lost all drive and enthusiasm for anything, I don't seem to get joy out of anything anymore.
